description_html:
A lovely example of a modernised type 21 flat with a white gloss kitchen, updated bathroom and extended lease. Located on the first floor of one of the most popular blocks in the Barbican Estate, with south facing views over the residents' gardens. Relevant permissions are in place for the flat to be renovated throughout. Extended lease.

This flat has been fully modernised, with a contemporary kitchen, updated shower over bath and fitted wardrobes in each of the two double bedrooms. The bedrooms face north over the podium, tucked away from any public roads, whilst the spacious reception room provides tranquil views over the private residents' gardens.

The property is serviced by a lift which can bring residents down to the podium or to street level. A residents' car park (parking available from Barbican Estate Office) has a 24-hour car park attendant.

Ideally located in the centre of the Estate, residents can easily access the Barbican Arts Centre and can take a short walk to the shops and restaurants in Farringdon, Clerkenwell and Cheapside.

Convenient transport links include the Elizabeth and Thameslink lines from Farringdon Station; Circle, Hammersmith & City, and Metropolitan lines from Barbican Station; Northern line from Moorgate Station.

Tenure: Leasehold Lease Years Remaining: 170
Service Charge: £6,361 (Yearly)
Annual Ground Rent: £0
Council Tax Band: E
